sentences.text: The Independent Commission Against Corruption monitored NSW hospitals in 1993/94 to assess whether management had effectively implemented earlier cash-handling recommendations.
sentences.support:
The main aim of the cash handling monitoring project outlined in 
the following report was to find out if management action

sentences.text: The project visited two large hospitals and analysed questionnaire results from 33 other hospitals of different sizes.
sentences.support:
the ICAC project team visited two large hospitals 
and analysed the results of a questionnaire

sentences.text: The Commission found implementation worked best where senior management provided leadership, allocated tasks and coordinated the changes.
sentences.support:
implementation of the forty-six cash handling recommendations 
was most effective in the hospital visited where senior management provided strong leadership

sentences.text: It provided an implementation checklist covering responsibility, planned changes, resources, staff training and reviews of whether new systems achieved their aims.
sentences.support: Set a date for review to ensure new procedures and systems have achieved the stated outcomes

findings.quote:
The cash handling monitoring project confirmed management involvement and guidance can 
increase the effectiveness of implementation.
Train all staff who will use new procedures, equipment or documents.

notes: The 46 recommendations were made in the 1992 report. This follow-up provides monitoring principles and an implementation checklist.
